name: sample.hosted
//: Dependency versions are pinned exactly to prevent supply chain attacks and guarantee reproducible builds.
//test: The unit runner discovers .test.js and .test.ts files recursively. Playwright .spec.js/.spec.ts files run via test:browser. TypeScript execution does not type-check tests.

scripts.build:test:all: npm run build && npm run test:all
scripts.format: oxfmt --write buildwww vite.config.ts vite.config.plugin.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check buildwww vite.config.ts vite.config.plugin.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives buildwww vite.config.ts vite.config.plugin.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:styles && npm run type-check && npm run check:unused -- --no-exit-code
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:app && npm run build:appPostload && npm run build:htmx && npm run build:bootstrap && npm run build:react && npm run build:behaviors
scripts.build:behaviors: npm run build:behaviors:layout && npm run build:behaviors:home && npm run build:behaviors:test
